examples.title: First Terrain
examples.description: A mountain, rain that erodes it and an Unreal Landscape: the three nodes every project has. Start here and change one value at a time.

examples.title: Alpine Range
examples.description: A snow-capped range over foothills, cut by rivers, rain and rockfall. Exports rock, scree, grass and snow layers and a color map.

examples.title: Temperate Hills
examples.description: Rolling green hills drained by a river network, with lakes in the hollows. Shows how rivers and lakes become masks for water and banks.

examples.title: Volcanic Island
examples.description: A cone with a crater lake on an island with beaches and a shallow shelf. Shows the sea level, the coast and masks for sand and rock.

examples.title: Desert Canyons
examples.description: A layered plateau cut by canyons that falls to a sea of dunes. Shows how a mask joins two landforms and keeps the rain off the sand.

examples.title: Cratered Highland
examples.description: Old and young impact craters around one great basin, softened by slumped walls and a blanket of dust. A world without water.
